text:
noah (People Ops): Quick routing help 0s: hiring wants a sign-on + defered benefits carve for an internal transfer to the US. This needs an exception because benefits vest timing would normally be later.

emily (Recruiter): Candidate: Samir Gupta, internal SDET transferring teams. Proposed: base within band, $6k sign-on, and benefits eligibility effective at 30 days instead of standard 90. Manager asked to fast-track for Apr 5 start.

rafe (Hiring Manager): Samir is the de facto infra test lead. If we delay start we lose coverage on the automation rollout. Recommend approve sign-on + benefits deferral. Will provide a 2-line business impact note.

carmen (Finance): Need cost calc for sign-on and impact of changing benefits effective date (estimated additional employer cost for 60 days). Also confirm headcount change and GL for sign-on.

nora (Legal): Note: benefits eligibility changes must be reflected in offer language and benefits vendor informed. Also ensure internal transfer paperwork and any repapering is done. Recommend conditional approval pending vendor confirmation.

noah (People Ops): Plan: create APPR-4995 to Exec Comp and Benefits team. Attach offer draft, finance calc, and manager note. Ask for 48hr review. Emily, please upload offer and headcount memo.

emily (Recruiter): Uploaded offer draft to /files/SamirG-offer.pdf and headcount memo https://docs.internal/sg-transfer. Candidate ok with "pending benefits vendor confirmation" start.

approvals-bot: Approval request APPR-4995 created. Status: pending. Routed to: exec-comp, finance, benefits, legal. SLA: 48 hours. Link: https://approvals.internal/APPR-4995

carmen (Finance): I'll run the cost delta and post GL strings. Provisional approval for sign-on if recruiting covers the one-time cost center mapping.

rafe (Hiring Manager): I'll add the business impact note to the ticket and am available for a quick sync if exec-comp needs color.

noah (People Ops): Great. If approved we'll set start date as "pending benefits vendor confirmation" and add conditional language for benefits effective date in the offer. Please react with :thumbsup: once you've left your comment on APPR-4995.

(rafe) :thumbsup: (carmen) :thumbsup: (nora) :eyes:
